items.title: Mojo is now fully open source
items.oneliner: Apache 2.0 compiler and toolchain you can build today for GPU and accelerator programming with LLVM-based performance.

items.title: Rust vector search fits in RAM
items.oneliner: Rust ANN library indexes 10 million vectors in 4 GB RAM with Python bindings and no training phase.

items.title: Static Linux apps can use GPUs
items.oneliner: Custom ELF loader lets static musl binaries access host GPU drivers without shipping glibc-linked dynamic dependencies.

items.title: Local Logitech remapping without telemetry
items.oneliner: Rust desktop tool remaps Logitech buttons, DPI, and SmartShift locally using TOML instead of Logitech Options+.

items.title: Patch Sierra softlocks automatically
items.oneliner: This repo finds walking-dead game states in classic Sierra adventures and patches them without game-specific rules.

items.title: Clipboard history for Ubuntu GNOME
items.oneliner: MIT-licensed GNOME extension adds searchable Win+V clipboard history for text and images with no background service.

items.title: CUDA bank conflicts explained practically
items.oneliner: Hands-on CUDA tutorial shows shared-memory swizzling formulas that cut bank conflicts without wasting memory on padding.

items.title: Python lowercasing can break security
items.oneliner: Deep dive shows how str.lower mismatches Unicode 3.2 IDNA rules and why case folding can become a vulnerability.

items.title: Modern HTML replaces more JavaScript
items.oneliner: Concrete examples show dialogs, popovers, details, datalists, and native inputs that remove common JavaScript UI glue.

items.title: A connectome-powered desktop fruit fly
items.oneliner: Open source macOS app simulates a 3D fruit fly using 23,000 neurons that reacts to your cursor in real time.
